title_zh: 约定接替照护一小时并确认联络方式

scenario.goal_zh: 确认亲人愿意接替一小时，约定回来时间与电话联络以便照护者出门休息

context_zh: 虚构家庭照护场景中，成年兄妹协调陪伴父亲的时间，不涉及治疗决定。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: Could you relieve me for an hour? I have been here with Dad all afternoon.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Of course. I can stay until seven. Have you had anything to eat?

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: Yes, he and I had soup together. I just need some fresh air.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I am relieved to hear that. You sounded as though you had not stopped all day.

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: It is a relief to know I can rely on you. I will be back by six thirty.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Go and enjoy the walk. Keep your phone with you, and I will call if either of us needs you.

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: Thanks. It is five thirty now, so that gives me the hour. I'll keep the phone on.

targets.sense_zh: 接替某人工作以让其休息
